SourceRef.description: Where a record or document lives in its home system.

record_type.description: The home system's own name for it, e.g. 'bill', 'Bill'.
record_type.title: Record Type

SourceRef.title: SourceRef

description: A file. `type` is what the source called it, which is not proof of what it is.

origin.description: External: produced outside the company (vendor, bank, auditor). AU-C 500 treats external evidence as more reliable. Use default_origin() when the source does not say.
origin.title: Origin

path.description: POSIX path to the file. In a dataset folder it is relative to that folder. From a live source it is wherever the connector saved its copy, and Sources.document_file() is the way to reach it.
path.title: Path

sha256.description: Hash of the file's bytes. For a live source the connector downloads the file and computes it, so the evidence stays tied to the exact file read.
sha256.title: Sha256

title: Document
